description: One chapter or time range of a video's transcript, with the same header as get_transcript. Pass chapter (an index or title from get_outline) or from/to (seconds, m:ss or h:mm:ss); from alone reads to the end, to alone reads from the start. Cost: the section's token count from get_outline (about 1k tokens per 5 minutes of speech).

chapter.description: A chapter index from get_outline, or a chapter title (exact, prefix, then substring match, case-insensitive)

from.description: Start time: seconds (754), m:ss (12:34) or h:mm:ss (1:02:03). Default: the start

language.description: Preferred transcript language (BCP-47, e.g. en, de). Default: the spoken language

mode.description: Transcript strategy: auto (captions, then speech-to-text), captions only, stt (always transcribe), video (multimodal model). Default: auto

timestamps.description: Prefix lines with [m:ss] timestamps. Default: true

to.description: End time (exclusive), same forms as from. Default: the end

url.description: Video URL (YouTube and more), a YouTube video id, or a local media file path

name: get_section
title: Get a transcript section
